literature_corrections.current_sheet: vx = 0.1 sin(pi y) on [0,2]^2 per Gardiner & Stone (2005) sec. 5.5 and RAMSES patch/mhd/sheet; previously FLASH's sin(2 pi y) (twice the wavenumber)
literature_corrections.kh_uniform/kh_localized: Tomida et al. (2026) sec. III.1-2: p=10, vx=+-1, a=0.05, vy=0.01 sin(2 pi x) exp(-y^2/0.2^2), Bx=0.01; previously p=1, vx=+-0.5, sin(4 pi x), sigma=0.1. Localized band: sech^2 with the Gaussian's FWHM (w=0.0945)
literature_corrections.kh_localized_dtjump: Tomida sec. III.3 timing: dt x 1/40 for 100 steps at t=3.0, run to t=3.2; methods glm, glm_hll16, glm_constch, ct so the c_h policy is compared on one kernel
